hooks.name: Pre-submit: full gate
hooks.description: When a spec task is marked complete (PostTaskExec — a documented trigger in the IDE and CLI v3; `Manual` is not invocable in either, see kiro.dev/docs/hooks/types), run the full submission gate: the whole test suite, strict type-check, the Maker build, the real-browser checks, the sample freshness check and the README claim checker. To run it on demand, include the steering file `pre-submit` (`#pre-submit` in chat) or run `npm run pre-submit`.
